g.title: ✔ Per-process address spaces, switching on context switch (PCID where available)

✔ VFS core: inodes, dentries, mounts, file descriptor tables, path lookup

✔ First Linux syscalls: write, exit_group, brk, mmap, munmap, arch_prctl

✔ Thread-local storage, futex, robust futex lists, set_tid_address
✔ Signals: delivery, handlers, sigaltstack, rt_sigreturn, process groups
✔ Pipes, poll / select, epoll, eventfd, timerfd, signalfd
✔ Time syscalls and a vDSO (clock_gettime without a syscall)
✔ Dynamic linking: glibc's own ld.so loads shared libraries unchanged

✔ TTY layer: line discipline, pseudo-terminals, job control

✔ Networking: virtio-net driver, own TCP/IP stack (IPv4, IPv6, TCP, UDP, ICMP)
✔ Sockets: AF_INET, AF_INET6, AF_UNIX (incl. fd passing), AF_NETLINK basics
✔ Linux namespaces / seccomp basics (needed by browsers' sandboxes)
✔ Milestone (proof of concept a): a recorded trace of a simple Linux CLI app passes

Winsock (ws2_32) on our sockets; winhttp / wininet basics
